# MANO RIVER DIAMONDS — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> MANO RIVER DIAMONDS is a private diamond office specializing in natural fancy color diamonds, particularly Fancy Vivid Yellow and Fancy Intense Yellow. The brand emphasizes exclusivity, rarity, and trust, sourcing rough diamonds from the Mano River region in West Africa (Liberia & Sierra Leone) and polishing them in Israel's prestigious Ramat Gan Diamond Exchange. The aesthetic is quiet luxury - dark, elegant, and minimal with cinematic presentation, communicating long-term value and refined expertise to discerning B2B clients.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About MANO RIVER DIAMONDS
MANO RIVER DIAMONDS is a private diamond office specializing in natural fancy color diamonds, particularly Fancy Vivid Yellow and Fancy Intense Yellow. The brand emphasizes exclusivity, rarity, and trust, sourcing rough diamonds from the Mano River region in West Africa (Liberia & Sierra Leone) and polishing them in Israel's prestigious Ramat Gan Diamond Exchange. The aesthetic is quiet luxury - dark, elegant, and minimal with cinematic presentation, communicating long-term value and refined expertise to discerning B2B clients.

## Target Audience
B2B diamond traders, high jewelry houses, collectors, and serious buyers

## Industry
luxury diamonds and precious stones
